title: If I were you
goal: Say what would happen, or would have happened, if things were different.

intro.text: For what is not so, keep `-sA` in the **if** half and put the main verb in `-ArdY`, **would**: *Wagtym bolsa, gelerdim* (if I had time, I would come). For the past, use `-An bolsa`: *Ir turan bolsam, ýetişerdim* (if I had got up early, I would have made it).

vocab.en: in your place (Men seniň ýeriňde bolsam: if I were you)

exercises.question: How do you say **if I had time, I would come** (but I don't)?

why.1: *Gelerin* is **I'll come**: a real possibility, not a wish.
why.2: That says **I had time and I came**.

exercises.explain: `-sA` in the **if** half, `-ArdY` in the main verb: *gelerdim*, I would come.

exercises.label: *gitmek* + `-ArdY`: I would go, you would go…
exercises.explain: The t of *git-* softens before a vowel: *gider-*, then *-di* and the past endings.

exercises.en: If I had money, I would buy a new car.

reject.why: *Alaryn* is **I will buy**. For **would**, add *-dy* and the past ending: *alardym*.

exercises.explain: *Pulum bolsa* (if I had money), *alardym* (I would buy): I have none now.

exercises.prompt: If I were you, I would call her.
accept: Men seniň ýeriňde bolsam, oňa jaň ederdim.
Seniň ýeriňde bolsam, (men) oňa jaň ederdim.
Men seniň ýeriňde bolsam, men oňa jaň ederdim.
(Men) siziň ýeriňizde bolsam, (men) oňa jaň ederdim.

reject.answer: Men seniň ýeriňde bolsam, oňa jaň ederin.

exercises.explain: *seniň ýeriňde* (in your place) + *bolsam*, then *ederdim* (I would do).

accept: If I had got up early, I would have caught the train.
If I had got up early, I would have made the train.
If I had got up earlier, I would have [caught|made] the train.
If I had [gotten|woken] up [early|earlier], I would have [caught|made] the train.
I would have [caught|made] the train if I had [got|gotten|woken] up [early|earlier].

exercises.question: *Gelerdim* can mean two things. In which sentence does it mean **I would come**?

why.1: *Çagakam her gün*: as a child, every day. Here it is **I used to come**.
why.2: *Öň* (before) makes it a past habit: **I used to come here a lot**.

exercises.explain: With an **if** half, `-ArdY` means **would**; with *öň*, *her gün* or *çagakam*, **used to**.

exercises.prompt: If I were a bird, I would fly.
If I had known, I would have told you.
exercises.explain: *Bilen bolsam* (if I had known: the past), *aýdardym* (I would have told).

exercises.text: Ol jaň etme___ bolsa, men bilmezdim.
exercises.en: If he hadn't called, I wouldn't have known.

reject.why: Before *bolsa* the verb is a participle: the negative of *eden* is *etmedik*.
`-sA` is already on *bolsa*. Before it, use the participle: *etmedik*.

exercises.explain: *jaň etmedik bolsa*: if he hadn't called. *-madyk, -medik* is the negative of `-An`.

accept: If I were you, I would not go.
If I was you, I would not [go|leave].
If I were you, I would not leave.
I would not [go|leave] if I [were|was] you.
In your place, I would not [go|leave].
If I had been you, I would not have [gone|left].

exercises.question: *Ir çykan bolsaň, ýetişip bilerdiň.* What does it mean?
options: If you had left early, you could have made it.
If you leave early, you can make it.
You left early and made it.

why.1: That would be *Ir çyksaň, ýetişip bilersiň*: a real possibility.
why.2: *Çykan bolsaň* is **if you had left**: you didn't.

exercises.explain: `-An bolsa` for the past, and *-(Y)p bilerdi* for **could have**.

exercises.prompt: If it weren't raining, we would go to the park.

reject.why: *Gideris* is **we'll go**: a real plan. For **would**: *giderdik*.

exercises.explain: *ýagmasa* (if it didn't rain) + *giderdik* (we would go): it is raining now.

exercises.prompt: If I were rich, I would buy a big house.
accept: Eger (men) baý bolsam, (men) uly (bir) jaý [alardym|satyn alardym].
Men baý bolsam, (men) uly (bir) jaý [alardym|satyn alardym].
Baý bolsam, men uly (bir) jaý [alardym|satyn alardym].
Baý bolsam, uly bir jaý [alardym|satyn alardym].
Baý bolsam, uly jaý satyn alardym.

reject.why: *Alaryn* is **I'll buy**, as if you might become rich. For **would**: *alardym*.

exercises.explain: *baý bolsam* (if I were rich: I'm not) + *alardym* (I would buy).
